description: Cross-implementation contract for rendering governance rubrics into a reviewer prompt. Rendered by codeguard.prompts.format_rubric_context (canonical) and by codeguard-action src/rubric_context.py (vendored copy, which cannot import the canonical module). Both must produce 'expected' byte-for-byte. Covers: multiple packs, a disabled rule, hostile free text that tries to close the block or inject tags, a non-string version, whitespace collapsing, field-length capping, a None entry, and a pack with no rules. Includes a rule whose ID and SEVERITY attempt to close the block and inject an instruction: those fields are cited verbatim in findings and were previously unsanitized.
